column1: # The routes of the proofs of TINNiK, and of the results of other works that they use: which numbered results each proof uses.
# Columns: label, environment, the paper proves it (1/0), results used.
# Every label is assigned here or taken from the paper's TeX, and appears in the docstrings of the Lean results. The results of Allman et al. 2023
# carry the labels of lean4-allman2023's routes file, prefixed by `allman2023:`.
# TINNiK (Algorithms Mol. Biol. 2024). Labels of unnumbered statements of Appendix C are assigned here.
# ==== Allman, Baños, Mitchell, Rhodes 2023, restated in Tinnik/External/Allman2023/ ====
# The results of lean4-allman2023 that the proofs use and that have a row in its routes file, docs/Allman2023/paper_routes.tsv, with
# its label prefixed by `allman2023:` and its routes among these rows. The other restated results, steps that the source states
# without a label, have no row.
# A claim of the source that TINNiK develops: the consistency of the outline of an algorithm in its Section 5, proved here from
# Written by hand from the sources that were read, each README saying which. Rows with paper-proves 1 are those whose printed proof the Lean proof is compared with.
